JavaScript that pushes a batch of files through Shiny's upload channel

Source: R/el_upload.R
dot-el_upload_js.Rd

Element calls http-request once per file, but Shiny's protocol is per-batch: uploadInit opens a job for a set of files, each is POSTed to the job's URL, and uploadEnd sets the input to that job's files. Running the protocol per file therefore makes each upload overwrite the last, so a three-file selection arrives as a single row.

Usage

.el_upload_js(ns_id)

Arguments

ns_id

The namespaced input id.

Value

An htmlwidgets::JS() object for the http-request prop.

Details

Element's uploadFiles() starts and uploads each file in one synchronous loop, so the calls are collected in a queue and flushed from a microtask, by which point the whole batch is present. Replacing only the transport this way leaves Element's file list, progress bars and its on-success, on-progress and on-error hooks working as they normally do.
